campbell.title: Campbell City Council — July 7, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council held a public hearing to renew a temporary local ordinance related to state legislation (Senate Bill), and considered revoking the business license and tobacco permits for two local shops, California Cigar and Hayes Smoke Shop. The council also reviewed a grant application for public works funding and a resolution to approve consultant service agreements.
keyTopics: Renewal of interim ordinance implementing state Senate Bill requirements
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for Hayes Smoke Shop
Public Works Director authorized to submit a 'One Big Area' grant application
Approval of consultant service agreements

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — May 20, 2026
saratoga.summary: The City Council adopted a resolution declaring its intent to identify properties that fall under a designated category as part of a formal city process. A public hearing has been set for June 17, 2026, where residents can raise protests before the Council considers final approval of the matter.
keyTopics: Resolution declaring intent to identify designated properties
Scheduling of June 17, 2026 public hearing
Process for residents to file protests
Upcoming vote on final approval of the designation

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — June 16, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council met to approve routine meeting minutes and handle several contract-related items, including extending agreements for services, legal counsel, and software. The council also authorized the Town Manager to enter into litigation-related legal services and approved a resolution correcting a prior document.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from June 2 and June 8 Town Council meetings
Fifth amendment to an existing town service agreement
Five-year software services agreement
Fourth amendment to the town's legal services contract
Authorization for litigation-related legal services

san-jose.title: San José City Council — June 23, 2026
san-jose.summary: This San José City Council meeting covered routine approvals of past council and committee meeting minutes, along with a few business items. The council also reviewed a retail concession agreement update at the airport, a change to airport fees and charges, and approved the City Manager's travel to Tampa, Florida.
keyTopics: Approval of prior City Council meeting minutes
Approval of Council Committee meeting minutes
Amendment to the airport retail merchandising concession agreement with PRI-San José, LLC
Update to the Airport Fees and Charges Rate schedule
City Manager's approved travel to Tampa, Florida

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — June 23, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council closed session covered potential litigation risks, followed by celebratory proclamations for Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's 100th anniversary, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's new judgeship. The Council also handled several budget and infrastructure items, including next year's spending limits, water planning, capital projects, and updates on the new Public Safety Building and Shoreline Golf Links parking lot.
keyTopics: Closed-door discussion on two potential lawsuits facing the city
Proclamations honoring Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's centennial, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's judicial appointment
Setting the city's legal spending limit and updating financial policy for FY 2026-27
Adopting the updated 5-year water management and drought contingency plan
Progress updates on the Public Safety Building, Shoreline Golf Links repaving, and South Bay Salt Pond restoration projects

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — July 21, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: Sunnyvale City Council held a special study session to discuss a proposal to eliminate the use of chemical pesticides on property owned or leased by the city, weighing options for alternative pest management approaches. The regular 7 P.M. council meeting followed, opening with the flag salute and standard procedural business.
keyTopics: Proposal to ban chemical pesticide use on city-owned or leased property
Alternatives to chemical pesticides for city land maintenance
Study session format for gathering council input before formal action
Regular council meeting opening procedures

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — July 30, 2026
cupertino.summary: This Cupertino committee meeting covered approval of prior meeting minutes, a general public comment period for topics not otherwise on the agenda, and two main business items: a program for permitting film shoots in the city and a discussion on making permits easier for small businesses to obtain.
keyTopics: Approval of April 30, 2026 meeting minutes
Open public comment period for non-agenda topics
Filming Permit Program discussion
Small Business Permit Streamlining proposal

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — July 14, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This notice mainly covers logistics for the Santa Clara City Council meeting on July 14, 2026, explaining that it will be held in a hybrid format with both in-person and remote participation options. It provides details on how residents can join via Zoom or phone, and how to submit written comments online before the meeting. No specific policy items or discussion topics were included in this portion of the agenda.
keyTopics: Hybrid meeting format (in-person and remote)
Zoom and phone access information for public participation
Instructions for submitting written public comments via eComment
Use of the City Council Legistar agenda page for meeting materials

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — June 9, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council met to approve the city's proposed operating budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year, setting spending plans for city services. Council also held public hearings on long-term water supply and drought response planning, and introduced new rules on backflow prevention (to protect drinking water) and on how the city conducts open, transparent government.
keyTopics: Approval of the Fiscal Year 2026-27 city operating budget
2025 Urban Water Management Plan public hearing and adoption
2025 Water Shortage Contingency Plan public hearing and adoption
New ordinance on backflow prevention and cross-connection control to protect water supply
Ordinance amendment on open governance rules for city meetings and decisions

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto City Council — July 8, 2026
palo-alto.summary: This Palo Alto City Council meeting starts with a routine director's report and scheduling update, followed by a public hearing on a rezoning proposal for 470 Olive Avenue. The council is being asked to change this property's zoning from single-family residential to medium-density mixed use so it matches the zoning of the neighboring parcel at 2951 El Camino Real, as part of the North Ventura area planning effort.
keyTopics: Rezoning of 470 Olive Avenue from single-family residential (NV-R1) to medium-density mixed use (NV-MXM)
Amending the North Ventura Coordinated Area Plan land use designation for the site
Aligning zoning with the adjacent parcel at 2951 El Camino Real
Director's report and upcoming council meeting schedule
Council member committee assignments
